children: The Icelandic Aircraft Mechanics Association (FVFÍ), representing aircraft mechanics employed by Icelandair, has called off the strike action that commenced at 00:01 on 23 September 2026.

As previously announced, the strike action resulted in disruptions to Icelandair’s flight operations and a number of flight cancellations earlier today. Following the withdrawal of the strike action, Icelandair expects its flight schedule to return to normal from later today.
Asdis Petursdottir, Director Communications. E-mail: asdis@icelandair.is
